definitions.explanation: One of the colored segments that form a flower. Petals protect the reproductive parts and attract pollinators.

examples.english: Cherry blossom petals are dancing in the wind.

examples.japanese: {花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}り→散る：02075_chiru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The petals have started to fall.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦いく→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The white petals are falling one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}たれて→打つ：01221_utsu⟧{花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: The petals all fell off after being beaten by the rain.

notes:
{花弁|かべん} refers to flower petals.

Alternative reading: {花弁|はなびら} (more colloquial)

Common expressions:
- {花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}る→散る：02075_chiru⟧ (petals scatter/fall)
- {花弁|かべん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：00689_aku⟧ (petals open)
- ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧ (single-petaled)
- ⟦{八重|やえ}→八重：29805_yae⟧ (double-petaled, many petals)

Counter: ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧

Note:
{花弁|かべん} is the formal/scientific term, while {花弁|はなびら} is more commonly used in everyday speech. The poetic image of cherry blossom petals (⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{花弁|はなびら}) scattering in the wind is iconic in Japanese culture.
